semiconductor_relevance: Medium — ABB India Limited provides power protection solutions that are critical for maintaining power quality in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ABB India Limited offers power protection solutions, including medium voltage UPS systems and active voltage conditioners, to ensure reliable power distribution and continuity in semiconductor manufacturing. Their products address power quality issues, safeguarding against interruptions and fluctuations, and include cybersecurity measures to protect mission-critical applications.
capabilities: Power switches for reliable power distribution
